Our Superb Pho Experience! 5 Stars!
Oct 2026 • Friends
Such a wonderful dining experience at Huyĕn Huong Pho Ga! 🇻🇳❤️

My friends and I really enjoyed our visit. The ambiance was lovely, with a cool, dining area and a simple menu that wasn't overwhelming.

We ordered the pork pho, special chicken pho, and chicken rice, and everything was absolutely delicious! The servers were friendly, approachable, and very accommodating. They even gave us extra soup for free when we requested it!

Definitely one of the highlights of our stay in Vietnam. Great food, excellent service, and a lovely dining experience. Highly recommended!
